label: LINZ reports national topographic digital database completed
summary: The May 1999 Landlink newsletter documented a four-year programme converting 330 published 1:50,000 map sheets into a seamless digital topographic database containing about 12 GB of data.

sources.label: LINZ Landlink, issue 8, May 1999, p.1, 'LINZ first in mapping', digitised scan supplied by Nathan Heazlewood; public image copy not yet available
